notes: Posted 12 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

No starting section is posted; the objective (posted 'Tdigwatt/pidaiaf'), Prepared Defenses and the starting sites are in the normal sections and count toward the 60. The strategy says he gets his two sites before activating and 'drop[s] ychf for s&d', so You Cannot Hide Forever is the starting Effect (it can be lost to fetch Search And Destroy).

The description says the deck 'helped me win Ramapo DPC'; the strategy adds that it 'worked at dpc (not every game)'. Alan Sagan's DeckTech 16877 says his only day-1 loss at the Ramapo DPC was to 'Don Kitzman's Speed deal', and Joe Olson's DeckTech 17063 thanks '"Dan" (Don) Kitzman - For winning the DPC'. The event is taken as RamapoCon III (June 2001).
Byline is Don "Chef" Kitzman; the post is signed 'Dan Kitsman'. Credited as Don Kitzman (byline; Olson's post gives '"Dan" (Don) Kitzman').

Two-sided generic cards dested the Dark pages: Bespin (Dark), Bespin: Cloud City (Dark), Cloud City: Casino (Dark), Cloud City: West Gallery (Dark), Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber (Dark), Lando Calrissian (Dark), Trooper Sabacc (Dark), Cloud City Sabacc (Dark) (posted 'CC Sabacc').

Posted 'IAO' dested Imperial Arrest Order; 'Lt. Commander Arden' dested Lieutenant Commander Ardan; 'Trooper Jeroel Blendin' dested Trooper Jerrol Blendin; 'Zuckass n/Mist Hunter' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'OS-72-2 n/Obsidian 2' dested OS-72-2 In Obsidian 2; 'Sense/Uncertain is the future' dested Sense & Uncertain Is The Future; 'Were in attack position now' dested We're In Attack Position Now. Secret Plans and No Escape are 2001 Effects, counted in the 60.
